observations: Photo 0: Front of a black DSLR body with 'Canon' and 'EOS 5D' lettering visible, no lens attached (body cap on), on a blue sofa with a TV in background.
Photo 1: Rear of the same body showing 'Canon' logo, LCD screen (screen appears off/black), control buttons (MENU, INFO, RATE, SET, joystick), hot shoe visible on top with no flash/trigger attached.
Photo 2: Front view again showing 'Canon', 'EOS 5D' and 'MarkIII' engraved near the shutter button, small top LCD panel showing some info, body cap still on, no lens.
No batteries, charger, or Godox trigger are visible in any of the three photos.
No lens is attached or shown in any photo.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'OA PROPERTIES' are overlaid on all images.

claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1, and 2 all clearly show 'Canon' and 'EOS 5D Mark III' markings; no Sony branding anywhere.
Photos 0, 1, 2 show Canon EOS 5D Mark III body markings.
No batteries are shown in any of the three photos.
No charger is shown in any of the three photos.
Hot shoe is empty in photo 1; no trigger is visible in any photo.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function (shutter, sensor, autofocus).
risks.proof: A clip or photo showing the camera powered on, LCD displaying a live image, and shutter firing.

risks.risk: Shutter count unknown, which heavily affects value on a used 5D Mark III.
risks.proof: Photo of the shutter count from a menu screen or EOSInfo app reading.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high/unknown shutter count (lowest tier)

risks.risk: No lens included, but price expectations for '5D Mark III' listings often assume a kit lens.
risks.proof: Photo showing a lens included in the sale.

risks.risk: Claimed accessories (2 batteries, charger, Godox trigger) are not visible in any photo and may not be included or may not work.
risks.proof: A single photo laying out the body plus all claimed accessories together.

risks.risk: LCD screen condition/functionality cannot be confirmed; screen appears off/black in photo 1.
risks.proof: Photo or clip of the LCD screen powered on and displaying menu/image.

risks.risk: Physical wear, dents, or sensor/mirror damage not visible from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of lens mount interior, sensor, and all body corners/edges.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically average/worst visible condition

risks.risk: Listing text claims a different brand (Sony) than what is shown, suggesting a possibly reused or careless/templated listing.
risks.proof: A corrected, consistent listing description from the seller matching the photographed item.
risks.if_unproven: treated as a red flag but not disqualifying, since photos are internally consistent and clearly Canon

proof_requests: Photo of the camera powered on with a live view image on the LCD.
Photo/screenshot of the shutter actuation count from the camera menu.
Single photo showing the body together with both batteries, the charger, and the Godox trigger.
Close-up photos of the lens mount, sensor area, and top/bottom/side body edges for dents or wear.
Clarification/correction of the brand stated in the listing text.
response.reason: The photos clearly and consistently identify the item as a Canon EOS 5D Mark III body with no lens; the 'Sony' brand claim in the text is contradicted by the photos and treated as a listing error rather than proof. Claimed accessories and functionality are unverified, so the item is priced at worst case (body-only, untested) pending further proof.
